source_title: Narodne novine 110/2019 (29.11.2019.): Zakon o blagdanima, spomendanima i neradnim danima u Republici Hrvatskoj

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Self-employed income tax (obrt, free professions)
value: Income from self-employment (receipts less expenses, with bookkeeping) is taxed at the lower and higher rates of the place of residence, like salary; or the flat-rate paušal regime below
note: Paušal bands and contribution bases follow.
source_title: Porezna uprava (Ministry of Finance, Tax Administration): Porezne stope godišnjeg poreza na dohodak

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Flat-rate regime (paušalni obrt)
value: Crafts with receipts of at most €60,000 a year and not in the VAT system: tax 12% of a deemed annual income set by receipts band (receipts less 85% expenses at the top of the band), paid quarterly
note: Paušal bands and contribution bases follow.

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Digital-nomad temporary stay
value: Yes: non-EU/EEA nationals working through communication technology for a company (or their own company) not registered in Croatia; up to 18 months; new application 6 months after expiry
note: Paušal bands and contribution bases follow.
source_title: Ministry of the Interior of the Republic of Croatia (MUP): Temporary stay of digital nomads

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Digital-nomad stay: means of subsistence per month (2.5 × the average monthly net salary of the previous year)
note: Or €43,470 in a bank account for 12 months, €65,205 for 18 months; +10% of the average net salary per family member
source_title: Ministry of the Interior of the Republic of Croatia (MUP): Temporary stay of digital nomads

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Digital-nomad stay: tax consequence
value: No income tax on receipts from employment or activity for an employer not registered in Croatia under digital-nomad status (Income Tax Act art. 9(1) point 26)
note: Paušal bands and contribution bases follow.
source_title: Narodne novine 138/2020 (11.12.2020.): Zakon o izmjenama i dopunama Zakona o porezu na dohodak

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Inbound regime: returnees
value: Croatian emigrants and descendants returning after at least 2 years abroad: 100% reduction of the income tax on salary for 5 years (from 1 January 2025)
note: Paušal bands and contribution bases follow.
source_title: Porezna uprava: Posebne olakšice (Umanjenja povratnicima)

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Inbound or expat regime for foreign nationals
value: None: the special reliefs are for pensioners, war invalids, Vukovar and assisted areas, people up to 30 and returning Croatian emigrants; other new residents are taxed on worldwide income at the local rates
note: Paušal bands and contribution bases follow.
source_title: Porezna uprava: Posebne olakšice (Umirovljenici)

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Application authority
value: Digital-nomad stay: Ministry of the Interior (online application forwarded to the police administration or station; visa nationals apply at a Croatian embassy or consulate); fee €46.45 at the police or €55.74 at a consulate. Tax and contributions: Porezna uprava
note: Paušal bands and contribution bases follow.
source_title: Ministry of the Interior of the Republic of Croatia (MUP): Temporary stay of digital nomads
